messages:
Alex: morning async — quick standup. What I did: updated the Q3 content calendar (moved benchmark post to Wed), drafted the benchmark post (needs final numbers), opened PR #452 for analytics dashboard tweaks. Blockers: waiting on eng review for #452, noticed a ~30ms tail latency bump on the gen canary. Today: ping eng for review, finalize copy, coordinate launch checklist. @Priya can you take an early pass on the draft? link: https://notion.redwood/content/bench-draft :eyes:

Priya: on it — will read the draft after standup. I can review PR #452 later this morning. Regarding latency bump, can you paste the trace or a span id? Might be the new batching change. :thinking_face:

Alex: trace id: trace-9a7c. Quick snippet from console logs: ```gen_latency_p95: 120ms -> 152ms after change```. Not huge but noticed on canary traffic. Miguel might already be looking.

Sam: I can take PR #452 now. Will check analytics code + any regressions. For canary, if it's KV-cache related we can toggle the canary back or reduce weight. Command I usually run: `redwoodctl rollout set-weight --canary=0.1` (reduces to 10%).

Miguel: seeing increased cache miss rate on canary nodes — KV cache hit drops ~12%. Investigating whether recent runtime change bumped cache keys. Will dig into host metrics and report back in ~30m.

Jordan: re: content calendar — if we move benchmark post to Wed we should push the social assets monday EOD. I'll own assets if you finalize copy by noon. Also want to confirm the launch checklist: do we need a post-launch rollback plan doc link?

Alex: yes Jordan — please draft rollback steps (simple steps for switching to baseline model + contact points). I'll add the checklist here once PR is in.

deploy-bot: canary rollout observed increased error rate at 2025-11-02T09:12:14Z, alert triggered (incident-246).

Priya: noted — will prioritize copy + QA once Sam posts review comments. If the canary is unstable we should pause publishing the benchmark until numbers are stable. :thumbsup:

Sam: PR #452 review done — left comments + small refactor suggestion. Miguel, ping me if you want assistance debugging KV keyspace changes.

Miguel: thanks, Sam. Found one change in key generation that explains the misses; will push fix in 20m and re-run canary.

Alex: perfect, thanks everyone. If canary stabilizes by 11:30 I'll finalize the benchmark numbers and tag Jordan for assets. Otherwise we hold a day. :sparkles:
